L.ordering: In parent SHA order, select each parent's minimum-SHA lawful child if not already selected; then fill by candidate SHA ascending.

O.implementation_note: Preserve the exact Counter-based v0.18.3 expression.

S.implementation_note: Preserve the exact record-field expression used by the v0.18.3 adapter; rename only after an audited semantic refactor.

candidate_count_rule: N = min(256, exact unique candidate count). If N < 256, complete the level with all candidates and raise LOW_CANDIDATE_SUPPORT as a scientific pause trigger.
lineage: Exact generalization of L16 v0.18.3 selection semantics; no scientific change.
union: Set union of the five lane SHA lists, sorted SHA ascending.
